text: Qatar Sports Investments (QSI) - owner of Paris Saint-Germain, wholly owned by the Qatar Investment Authority, Qatar's sovereign wealth fund - agreed in October 2022 to buy 21.67% of Sporting Clube de Braga (share purchase agreement with Olivedesportos, SGPS S.A., disclosed to Portugal's securities regulator CMVM); by 2023 QSI held 29.60% of the football SAD.
short: QSI (Qatar Investment Authority) holds a minority stake in SC Braga's football SAD

source.name: Plataforma Media, 'PSG owner buys minority stake in SC Braga' (CMVM disclosure); Wikipedia S.C. Braga ownership section for the 29.60% 2023 figure
